tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Equipment for KITS Innovation Lab
tenderSchedule.description: Procurement of scientific and technological equipment for the establishment and strengthening of the KITS Innovation Lab at Proudhadevaraya Institute of Technology -PDIT, Hosapete, under the LEAP initiative. The procurement includes CO2 Laser Engraving & Cutting Machine, CNC Router Machine 1 Nos each, High-Performance GPU Desktop Workstations 5 Nos. and High-Performance Laptop 1 No, along with necessary accessories, installation, commissioning, demonstration and training, as per the approved technical specifications.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Preference, where legally permissible and included in the approved tender, may be accorded to eligible DPIIT-recognized startups, Startup Karnataka-recognized entities, or bidders with relevant innovation / rapid prototyping / CNC / AI computing deployment experience. Documentary proof shall be required.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: CA-certified turnover / financial statements for the period specified in the final bid.
Declaration of equipment warranty, maintenance and support arrangements.
GST registration certificate and applicable statutory compliance.
OEM authorization where required for the offered equipment.
PAN and income-tax returns for the preceding three financial years, if required.
Relevant supply / installation experience certificates or work orders.
Technical brochures and a compliance statement against Annexure I of E Tender Notification
